title: bl_land.ops_token gives a token that starts with an underscore or a digit, which ql_capture refuses, so the land.step row of a project whose push program starts that way is dropped
goal: bl_land.ops_token returns a token that ql_capture.ops_problems accepts for a label that starts with an underscore or a digit

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,"_tools"); import bl_land, ql_capture; bad=[(a, ql_capture.ops_problems({"event":"land.step","item":"BG-aaaaaaaa","step":bl_land.ops_token(a),"exit":0,"ms":1})) for a in ("_x.py sync --push","2tool sync --push")]; bad=[b for b in bad if b[1]]; print(bad); sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)

notes: Found by the SP-w57bnhhx review on 2026-10-26 (fresh-context reviewer, probed on the tip of the main branch); not S1, so parked as a draft in no sprint.
